intuition: Choose a middle value as each subtree root so both recursive halves stay height-balanced.

brute_force.approach: Insert sorted values one at a time into a BST, then rebalance the resulting skewed tree.

optimal.approach: Recursively use the middle index and construct the left and right slices as subtrees.
optimal.space: O(log n) recursion for a balanced result

edge_cases: An empty array produces an empty tree.
Several valid balanced shapes are acceptable; compare balance and inorder values.
